event.juno_heart8.intro.text: Today's the day. The right one. I checked twice. I'm showing Bram the horseshoe. Stand next to me? I sweat less with company.
event.juno_heart8.intro.why: variety pass: the triple-okay opened five scenes; keeps heart 6's 'right day' callback

event.juno_birthday.intro.text: My birthday! I'm not nervous! I labeled the cake 'Cake (Birthday)', in case of confusion. Come in!
event.juno_birthday.intro.why: drops the triple-okay opener; nerves still show without the tic

event.juno_courtship.intro.text: Deep breath. Mine, not yours. I made a list. 'Reasons I Like the Farmer.' Forty items. I'd read it, but I'd faint. So. Would you court me?
event.juno_courtship.intro.why: drops the triple-okay opener; the tic now belongs to heart 2 and next_door only

event.juno_heart5.2.text: Don't lose it! ...It's still Bram's pattern. Every line. Mine's still under the coal bin, getting braver.
event.juno_heart5.2.why: heart 2 and heart 5 ended on the same shape; now heart 5 calls back the thirty sketches instead

event.story_notes_juno.intro.text: You saw nothing! ...You saw everything. Fine. Encouragement leaks out of me. I can't plug it.
event.story_notes_juno.intro.why: 'Don't look / okay, you looked' repeated heart 6's 'Don't come in / okay, come in' shape; heart 6 keeps it

event.juno_heart10.thanks.text: {if choice:shoe.wait}Bram saw the mark. He waited, like you did, then nodded once. Once! Next door has an empty sign hook.{else}Bram saw the mark and said 'Hm.' Then he said it again, quieter. That's a speech. Next door has an empty sign hook.{/if}
event.juno_heart10.thanks.why: else branch repeated heart 8's two-kinds-of-Hm joke; new tail, same meaning and thread

event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l1.text: There's a second label on my cake. It just says 'Eat'. Bram. Confess.
event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l1.why: all four Bram overheards opened with his name; varied, funniest word last

event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l1.text: I'm on your bench again, Bram. I fixed its wobbly leg myself. The joint's crooked. Don't look.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l1.why: opener variety across the Bram overheard set; content unchanged

event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l1.text: Someday I'll have my own forge, Bram. A tiny one. Maybe next door.
event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l1.why: opener variety; keeps the next-door thread word for word

event.overheard_tilda_juno_3.l1.text: If I ever had my own forge, Tilda... a small one... would you still feed me?
event.overheard_tilda_juno_3.l1.why: both Tilda overheards opened with her name; the conditional also sits earlier than bram_4's 'someday'
